title: design-delta design-side component snapshot
description: One of D7's two design-side snapshot files (`design-components.json`), written by `design-delta ingest` from a provider's raw gather envelope, read by `audit`/`verify`. Provider-agnostic (ADR-001 D12) — a census unit is 'the published component,' matched by `nodeId`, whatever tool produced it. Every snapshot is optional and degrades like missing if invalid (ADR-001 D7); this file is never hand-authored.

components.description: One entry per PUBLISHED component, across every configured design file (ADR-003: census scope is the union of every loaded contract's `sources.design.fileKey` — a project addressing several files still gets exactly one of this snapshot, ADR-001 D7). Census unit is a `COMPONENT_SET` or a variant-less `COMPONENT`, never a variant child.

provenance.description: When and how this snapshot was gathered (issue #389) — kept from the raw envelopes by `ingest`, never from the clock, so a report can state whether it rests on a fresh gather or a months-old committed file. Absent on a snapshot written before this field existed.

gatheredAt.description: The newest `gatheredAt` across the envelopes that ingested — a gather is as fresh as its newest file.

planHash.description: The `gather` plan every ingested envelope was produced from; absent when they disagree.

providerVersion.description: The provider version every ingested envelope reported; absent when they disagree.

engineVersion.description: The design-delta version that normalized this snapshot (issue #458). Normalization runs at `ingest`, so stored values are only as current as this engine; `audit` compares it against the provider's `normalizationSince`. Absent on a snapshot written before 0.19.0.

designLayer.description: One node of a design component's layer tree, in the engine's own vocabulary — never a design tool's raw node shape (ADR-001 D12). A contract's `anatomy` node is compared against this: by NAME (or the node's `designLayer`, when the two differ) and by `type`.

name.description: The layer's own name — the only correlation a contract's anatomy node has to it, which is why `designLayer` exists for the case where the two differ.

type.description: The SAME node-type vocabulary a contract's `anatomy.<node>.type` uses, so the two sides are directly comparable. Absent when the provider had no engine-side equivalent for this layer's own type — carried unclassified rather than guessed, and never compared.

children.description: Child layers, in the order the design tool reports them. An EMPTY array means 'checked, none'; absent alongside `childrenResolved: false` means 'not known'.

childrenResolved.description: `false` when this node's child list is NOT KNOWN — a nested component instance (whose subtree answers to its own contract), a node the gather surface reported no children for at all, or one some of whose children could not be censused. Nothing is compared under such a node.

fileKey.description: The design file this component was gathered from — the provider's own addressing vocabulary, opaque to the rest of the engine (ADR-001 D12). Combined with `nodeId`, the full join key against a contract's `sources.design`.

nodeId.description: Canonical, colon-separated (ADR-003: both separators accepted at ingest, normalized to `:` before this is written) — the join key against a contract's `sources.design.nodeId`, never `name`.

name.description: Display name only — never the match key (ADR-003: name-based matching is measured evidence of mispairing on a real project).

type.description: COMPONENT_SET = a published component with variants; COMPONENT = one without. A variant CHILD of a COMPONENT_SET is never its own entry here.

unit.description: What kind of census unit this is, in the engine's own vocabulary (issue #658): a `variant-set`'s gathered `layers` children are its variants, each a whole component; a `component`'s are its own layers. Derived from `type` at ingest, so it never disagrees with it; absent on a snapshot written before it, where `audit` derives the same answer itself.

variantProperties.description: Variant property name -> its declared option values, for a COMPONENT_SET. Absent for a variant-less COMPONENT.

propertyDefinitions.description: Non-variant component properties (text/boolean/instance-swap), keyed by the provider's own property identifier.

variantCombinations.description: Which variant combinations this component set actually PUBLISHES — one entry per combination, each a full `variant property name -> value` assignment (issue #403). Distinct from `variantProperties`, which says only which options each property offers: the product of those options is what a contract IMPLIES, this is what the design tool enumerates. Written by the bindings pass, which reads the one gather surface that returns a set's variant children; ABSENT (never `[]`) when that pass has not run or the component has no variants, so a reader can tell 'not gathered' from 'gathered, none'.

usedVars.description: Variable names this component's tree binds, when the provider's gather surface reports them.

layers.description: This component's own layer tree, normalized into the engine's node vocabulary, when the provider's gather surface reports it (issue #402) — what `anatomy/*` compares a contract's declared anatomy against on the design side. Absent means the tree was never gathered, which is never reported as drift.

rawProps.description: Provider-specific per-component detail not otherwise modeled — never read by core/modules, carried for a provider's own downstream use.

icon.description: Whether this component is an icon, per the project's configured icon convention. Omitted, never a guessed default, when the provider has no icon convention to apply.

treeHash.description: Deterministic hash of this component's normalized tree (ADR-001 D6) — hashed Node-side by `ingest`, never inside a design tool's own sandbox.
